blurb: Apple has deployed quantum-resistant cryptography in iMessage through the PQ3 protocol, combining classical elliptic-curve key agreement with ML-KEM (Module Lattice-based Key Encapsulation Mechanism), a NIST-standardized post-quantum algorithm. PQ3 provides Level 3 post-quantum security – the highest of any widely deployed messaging protocol – using HKDF-based ratcheting so future cryptographically-relevant quantum computers cannot retroactively decrypt past messages. The hybrid classical-plus-post-quantum approach ensures protection against both current classical cryptanalysis and anticipated future quantum attacks, with additional quantum-secure algorithms being progressively integrated into iCloud Keychain and other Apple security services.
